_comment: OPTIONAL hooks registration to merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (user scope), next to the permissions block from settings.json. Copy the hooks key into your settings.json. Use ABSOLUTE paths: user-scope hooks do not get $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, and some builds do not expand $HOME/%USERPROFILE% inside hook commands. Replace the ABSOLUTE_HOME placeholder with your real home path (e.g. /home/you or C:/Users/you). guard = recommended security hook; format/verify = convenience (allowlist-gated) — delete the blocks you do not want. For Windows, swap each command for: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Users\you\.claude\hooks\guard.ps1".
